results.proof: The weight condition forces every component to be rational, so the dualising sheaf is a sum of line bundles of negative degree. The vanishing for each summand is the local computation of \cite[Theorem 1.1]{other}, and the compatibility of the two normalisations is the point of \cite{third}.
results.statement: Let $C$ be a weighted stable curve of genus $g$ with weights summing to less than one. Then $H^1(C, \omega_C) = 0$.

results.proof: Immediate from Theorem~\ref{arxiv-2401.00002v1-thm-1.1} and Serre duality.
results.statement: Such a curve admits no infinitesimal automorphism.
